title: Line Tool 1
author: emulsifier
body:
Brian is still in the processing of moving into his new place, he is also getting ready for grad school and presumably has a ton of shit to get done. He STUPIDLY gave me permission to post a comic of some sort, and I have ZERO artistic ability. Hopefully I can fill in ok. This comic is based on my observations of Akimbo and Brian’s art and storytelling over the last few years.

I figured since most webcomics these days contain copious amounts of stick figures, most people will forgive me for this one. I don’t have photoshop, and if I did I would SUCK at it. So here are my Akimbo observations done entirely in paint.net

comments.author: b.patrick
comments.text: Man, that is bleak! Hilarious! Thanks for filling in, Rex. I found a place and should be back up and running very soon.
